painPoints.title: Inefficient manual project scheduling
painPoints.description: Manually tracking project timelines, resources and deadlines across multiple sites.

painPoints.title: Error-prone job costing and invoicing
painPoints.description: Inaccurate tracking of materials, labor and equipment costs leading to billing issues.

painPoints.title: Disjointed inventory and procurement processes
painPoints.description: Siloed data on materials, suppliers and orders leading to stockouts and waste.

painPoints.title: Repetitive payroll and compliance tasks
painPoints.description: Manual data entry, payroll processing and regulatory reporting for employees.

painPoints.title: Fragmented project performance reporting
painPoints.description: Difficulty consolidating data on budgets, timelines, safety and quality across projects.

painPoints.title: Slow change order management
painPoints.description: Cumbersome processes to document, approve and communicate project changes with clients.

painPoints.title: Inaccurate equipment maintenance tracking
painPoints.description: Lack of visibility into asset utilization, service history and replacement planning.

painPoints.title: Siloed HR and training records
painPoints.description: Disparate systems for employee certifications, safety training and workforce planning.

painPoints.title: Redundant data entry for billing
painPoints.description: Manually transferring project, time and expense data into accounting systems.

painPoints.title: Compliance reporting challenges
painPoints.description: Difficulty aggregating data and submitting mandatory reports on safety, taxes and regulations.
